nonPoolDecisions: Reading: all ten questions are required; each printed (a)/(b) part is a 5-mark practice card beside the whole question. Two-point items (“3 mharc + 2 mharc = 5 mharc”, or “An chéad … atá ceart = 3 mharc; an dara … atá ceart = 2 mharc”) are order-dependent (first correct point 3, second 2) and stay whole at 0/3/5; single answers allow 0/5, or 0/3/5 where the scheme prints a 3-mark partial answer.
Reading language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0 - 5 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh.” is one deduction from each 50-mark passage total; cards state it without applying it inside a part.

Prescribed prose (2A): (a) Dís prints five sub-questions the scheme prices at 5 each, each with its printed split (2 + 3; Mothúchán 1 + 2 + 2; Dhá phíosa eolais 2 + 3; Thaitin / Níor thaitin 1 + 2 + 2): the whole question is a 25-mark card and every sub-question is also a practice card. (b) is the film Cáca Milis or the play An Lasair Choille, a 25-mark card each (five points at 2 + 3).

Prescribed poetry (3A): each poem is a whole 25-mark card with its printed tariffs ((a) Géibheann: (i) 8, (ii) 8, (iii) 9; (b) An Spailpín Fánach: (i) 8, (ii) 8, (iii) 9) and one 0–4 Gaeilge deduction; every printed sub-question is also a practice card. 3A(b)(i) prints four questions (a)–(d) at 2 each: each question is also its own practice card.

Optional prose (2B) and optional poetry (3B) stay whole: the text is open content chosen by the candidate. 2B(b)'s optional film or optional play is one card with both printed alternatives; 3B(a) asks for a modern poem and 3B(b) an old one.
Choice is not a route: Ceist 2 and Ceist 3 are each A or B; each printed question is one card carrying the printed choice and “Freagair (a) agus (b) anseo.”; no combination cards.
Literature language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0-4 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh” is one deduction from each 25-mark question, never inside one sub-question.
caveats: Paper 2 = 200: Ceist 1 reading 100 (A Laoch ag Imeacht agus Laoch ag Teacht 50, B Ceiliúradh i gCathair Phort Láirge 50; ten questions at (a) 5 + (b) 5 each), Ceist 2 prose 50 (A Prós Ainmnithe: (a) Dís 25 + (b) Cáca Milis or An Lasair Choille 25; or B Prós Roghnach: (a) gearrscéal 25 + (b) scannán or dráma 25), Ceist 3 poetry 50 (A Filíocht Ainmnithe: (a) Géibheann 25 + (b) An Spailpín Fánach 25; or B Filíocht Roghnach: (a) a modern poem 25 + (b) an old poem 25).

The scheme’s text layer stores nine boxed headings with the page body (“CEIST 1 (A + B) - LÉAMHTHUISCINT - 100 marc”, “A – (50 marc)”, “B – (50 marc)”, the CEIST 2/3 and section boxes); the builder removes those exact strings (count pinned).

Each reading passage prints one note above Ceist 1 (“Nóta: Má tá dhá phointe eolais i gceist, tá 3 mharc ar an gcéad cheann atá ceart agus 2 mharc ar an dara ceann atá ceart.”), carried with every part’s key; the penalty note (“Nóta: Gearrfar pionós i ngeall ar iomarcaíocht. Léireofar an pionós …”) and the mark boxes close each passage, and the last part’s key ends before them.

Reading answers include refused answers printed at 0 (A 1(a) “Deireadh Fómhair = 0”), single answers priced “= 3 mharc nó 2 mharc” (A 3(b), by order), a bare list of accepted points under “Dhá phointe eolais as an liosta seo = 3 mharc + 2 mharc = 5 mharc” (A 5(a)) and “Na pointí seo a leanas:” (B 4(a)), and a printed requirement in brackets (B 5(a) “(Tá an dá rud … ag teastáil chun 5 mharc a bhronnadh ar an bhfreagra.)”).

2016 prints no general literature note (“Níl sé i gceist a chur in iúl go bhfuil na freagraí samplacha …”); each literature criterion carries its own scheme slice. Dís prints no sample answers, only each sub-question’s split.

Each literature answer ends with “[Gaeilge lochtach: 0-4 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh]” (ten: the six on the prose pages with a closing full stop, the four on the poetry pages without); each card's deduction carries its own print.

2B(a) gearrscéal roghnach prices “Príomhthéama an ghearrscéil = 3 mharc” and “4 phointe eolais ag teastáil (5 mharc an ceann) = 20 marc”, then title 1 + author 1; 2B(b) prices five points “(5 mharc an ceann ar an gcéad trí phointe eolais + 4 mharc an ceann ar an dá phointe eolais eile.)” (23) for the film or the play alike.

3A(b)(i) An Spailpín Fánach prints four questions (a)–(d), each priced bare “2 mharc” then “Freagraí Samplacha: …” with 1-mark partial answers for (a) and (b). 3B(i) prices “Dhá lomphointe = 2 mharc (1 mharc + 1 mharc) Forbairt = 7 marc (4 mharc + 3 mharc)”.

Scheme misprints kept as printed in the guidance: “Maureeen O’Hara” (A 1(a), second answer line), “Nota:” without its fada (Géibheann (i)), “an dá chinéal saoil” for “chineál” (Géibheann (iii) sample answers); in the modified-marking text (PDF 25, on no card) “Cuitear” for “Cuirtear” and “measunú” for “measúnú”.
The paper and scheme print ASCII hyphens (“t-ainm”, “nua-aimseartha”, “1-8”); cards keep them.
No 2016 Ordinary card existed before this review; the 54 cards are new.
